scenario.summary: Mantlemaze and other threat actors are employing 'AI-Analysis Evasion' (A3) by embedding natural-language instructions in malware to trick automated scrutiny, often pairing it with kernel-level driver abuse to disable EDR. These techniques are observed alongside high-impact threats including vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler and ransomware attacks by groups like Warlock.

hunt.name: Perimeter Vulnerabilities and Identity Access Abuse
hunt.description: This hunt examines two critical exposure points: the exploitation of the Citrix NetScaler perimeter (CVE-2026-88779) and the abuse of valid accounts for large-scale data harvesting. The hunt first scopes the environment for vulnerable Citrix instances, then fans out to monitor for service instability and anomalous spikes in identity search API calls. By correlating perimeter crashes with identity search behavior, the hunt identifies successful intrusions that leverage lawful access to bypass traditional MFA and alerting.

config.scoping_notes: Begin by identifying all Citrix NetScaler appliances in the environment using software inventory. If vulnerability scan data is available, prioritize those with active CVE-2026-88779 findings.
config.beyond_detection: A simple rule on HTTP 500s or high API usage is too noisy. This hunt uses the funnel approach to scope the perimeter, look for new crash patterns on specific paths, and correlate them with identity search anomalies that match the Danish CPR breach profile.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%netscaler%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%citrix%')
config.description: Scope the estate to find Citrix NetScaler instances that may be vulnerable to the reported memory overflow.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames running Citrix software. Silence suggests no managed NetScaler instances are visible in inventory.

primitive_config.label: Identify Citrix NetScaler inventory
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%netscaler%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%citrix%')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames running Citrix software. Silence suggests no managed NetScaler instances are visible in inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, status_code, COUNT(*) AS crash_count, MIN(time) AS first_error, MAX(time) AS last_error FROM hb_http_activity WHERE status_code >= 500 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_path, status_code
config.description: Detect server-side errors on NetScaler hosts that suggest a memory overflow or denial of service attack occurred.
config.expected_signal: A spike in HTTP 500 errors on specific paths. Silence suggests the NetScaler service is stable.

primitive_config.label: NetScaler HTTP service crashes
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, status_code, COUNT(*) AS crash_count, MIN(time) AS first_error, MAX(time) AS last_error FROM hb_http_activity WHERE status_code >= 500 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_path, status_code
primitive_config.expected: A spike in HTTP 500 errors on specific paths. Silence suggests the NetScaler service is stable.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS call_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sensitive_search_ops}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(api_operation) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING call_count > 100
config.description: Find users performing an excessive number of search or read operations, which may indicate the abuse of lawful access to extract sensitive records.
config.expected_signal: Identities with hundreds of search API calls from single IPs. Silence means no high-volume read patterns were detected in the audit log.

primitive_config.label: Anomalous identity search volume
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS call_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sensitive_search_ops}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(api_operation) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING call_count > 100
primitive_config.expected: Identities with hundreds of search API calls from single IPs. Silence means no high-volume read patterns were detected in the audit log.

config.objective: Determine whether the HTTP crashes on NetScaler hosts and the high-volume API searches by specific users together indicate active exploitation and data theft via lawful access abuse.
config.description: Correlate perimeter service instability with unusual identity search patterns to confirm a multi-stage intrusion.
config.expected_signal: A per-host and per-user verdict indicating risk level.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign citing specific row counts and temporal proximity between service errors and identity spikes.

config.question: the triage-incidents verdict is malicious for at least one host or user account

Halt further exploitation and data extraction.

config.instructions: Review the cited rows from HTTP and API logs. Verify if the identified searches are consistent with legitimate administrative tasks or if they match the Danish CPR breach pattern of abusing lawful access.

config.description: Ensure the perimeter is secured against future exploitation of CVE-2026-88779.
